prompt: You want to turn 1-butyne into 2-butanone. Which sequence works?

options.label: H₂O, H₂SO₄, HgSO₄ (acid-catalyzed hydration gives Markovnikov → ketone)
BH₃·THF then H₂O₂/NaOH (anti-Markovnikov → aldehyde, not ketone)
O₃ then DMS (cleaves the triple bond)

explanation: Markovnikov hydration of a terminal alkyne (Hg²⁺ catalysis) places OH on the internal C, giving an enol that tautomerizes to the methyl ketone (2-butanone). The anti-Markovnikov (BH₃) route gives the aldehyde.
